notes.claim: If one of two inversely proportional variables is doubled, the other is halved.
Boyle's law is stated in terms of absolute pressure: the volume of the gas varies inversely with it.
Atmospheric pressure must be added to a gauge reading to make absolute pressure before applying the gas law.
Standard sea-level atmospheric pressure is 1013.25 millibars (hectopascals), as NOAA gives it.
A 10 : 1 turns ratio gives a 10 : 1 primary to secondary voltage ratio and a 1 : 10 primary to secondary current ratio.
Gear reduction lowers rotational speed and raises load torque; because power is torque times speed, an ideal reducer trades one for the other.
Treating an inverse situation as if it were direct proportion is a documented error, and students were less successful on inverse than on direct proportion tasks.
Pearson's BTEC Higher National Engineering Science I unit lists determining ideal gas properties during a process.
Boyle's law (pressure × volume stays the same) is worked with the gas kept at a constant temperature.
